prompt: Use the product assembly-preparation path to check a six-part guided/retained single-cylinder slider-crank. The embedded declaration must pass selector part identity, part connectivity, export reconstruction, a declared assembly sequence, a correct removal sequence, the eccentric revolute fit and its measured joint frames. Wrong declarations or geometry must be rejected by the product layers.
notes: This family calls prepareContractAssembly, not a tool-level renderer or the A001 route.
It scores only the product-preparation layers that can be measured here: distinct parts, topology, reconstruction, declared assembly, declared disassembly, the eccentric fit and its joint frames.
Fit and joint frames cover only the eccentric revolute; main-shaft and wrist stations are not valid cylindrical probes in this fixture and remain NOT_RUN.
Motion, source motion and physical function remain unmeasured.
The assembly path is the declared insertion sequence, checked as the reverse of the declared removal paths, not as continuous transport.
